prompts.prompt: What two Tenable scores are combined, one being a 1-to-10 business-context rating and the other a dynamic threat-informed vulnerability score, to produce the Asset Exposure Score? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/tenable/SKILL.md - Vulnerability Priority Rating section: ACR (Asset Criticality Rating) combined with VPR, ACR times VPR exposure feeds the Asset Exposure Score (AES).

prompts.prompt: Roughly what percentage of vulnerabilities does a credentialed Tenable Nessus scan typically detect? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/tenable/SKILL.md - Credentialed vs. Uncredentialed Scanning table: Detection rate 95%+ for credentialed versus ~40-60% for uncredentialed.
